source.method: Onkelos-supported lexical anchors as starting point; every verse reviewed word by word (reviewed.json)

1:2.note: Word-for-word; Syriac 'his spirit of God' construct.

1:7.note: Relative d- renders asher; men completes compound prepositions.

1:9.note: Compound preposition d-l-tht men for mittahat.

1:11.note: Plus 'after its kind' for the herbs.

1:22.note: Le'mor rendered 'and said to them' (plus lhon).

1:26.note: Plus 'wild animals' (of the earth), as in Syriac/LXX tradition.

1:27.note: Object suffix on 'created him' renders oto.

1:29.note: 'Seed which is sown' paraphrase; asher (11) unrendered.

2:2.note: Peshitta reads 'sixth day' for MT 'seventh' (as LXX/Samaritan).

2:3.note: Object suffix on 'sanctified it' renders oto.

2:5.note: Hiphil 'cause rain' rendered 'bring down rain'; 'bush' rendered 'trees'.

2:16.note: Le'mor rendered 'and said to him' (plus leh).

2:19.note: Plus object 'them'; accusative et not rendered.

2:20.note: Plus 'all' before birds and leh; 'field' rendered 'earth'.

2:23.note: 'This time' for ha-pa'am; first zot (3) and final zot (15) unrendered.

3:1.note: Plus explicit subject 'the serpent'; af ki rendered 'truly'.

3:6.note: Lehaskil rendered 'to look at it' (plus beh).

3:8.note: 'Wind of the day' rendered 'turning of the day'.

3:10.note: MT 'I was afraid' read as 'I saw' (wa-ere').

3:15.note: Third/fourth 'between' rendered by lamad and bet.

3:17.note: Le'mor rendered 'and I said to you'.

3:21.note: Object suffix of wayyalbishem rendered by 'enon'.

3:24.note: Plus 'the LORD God'; 'drove out' rendered 'brought out'; wayyashken rendered 'set round'.

4:7.note: Second half inverted: 'you will turn to it and it will rule over you'.

4:8.note: Plus 'Let us go to the plain' (as SP/LXX).

4:9.note: Interrogative he rendered by gēr (left unlinked).

4:13.note: 'Too great to bear' rendered 'too great to be forgiven'.

4:15.note: Lakhen read as lo' ken 'not so' (as LXX); 'smite' rendered 'kill'.

5:2.note: Plus subject 'God'; suffixes rendered by enon.

6:4.note: Nephilim rendered 'giants'; asher rendered 'because'; hemma unrendered.

6:14.note: Gopher rendered 'juniper'; 'inside and outside' order reversed.

7:2.note: 'Man and his wife' rendered 'males and females'; 'two' doubled.

7:4.note: Mamtir rendered 'bring down rain'; yequm rendered 'what stands'.

7:11.note: Yom (11) unrendered; emphatic beh ('that very day').

8:7.note: Plus negation: raven 'went out and did not return'.

8:9.note: Plus 'there were' copula and dative leh.

8:21.note: Doublet 'odour of sweetness, odour of rest'.

9:2.note: Plus 'and upon' before all creeping things.

9:5.note: 'Every man's brother' rendered 'man and his brother'.

9:6.note: 'He made man' rendered passive 'Adam was made'.

9:14.note: Be'anni rendered 'when I bring up clouds'.

9:19.note: 'The whole earth' rendered 'in all the earth'.

11:28.note: 'In the face of' rendered 'in the lifetime of'.

12:1.note: Moledet paraphrased 'the place where you were born'.

12:13.note: 'You are my sister' rendered 'I am his sister'.

12:17.note: 'His house' rendered 'sons of his house'; plus leh.

13:6.note: 'Bear them' rendered 'suffice for them'; plus tav.

13:9.note: Left/right options swapped in order; plus pronouns 'you'.

13:10.note: 'Garden of YHWH' rendered 'paradise of God'; Zoar rendered 'Zoan'.

14:2.note: Ketiv/qere Zeboiim merged; doubled pronoun hi.

14:5.note: Rephaim rendered 'giants'; Zuzim 'strong ones'; beham 'among them'.

14:7.note: Kadesh rendered 'Reqem'; sedeh read as sare 'chiefs'; Hazazon-tamar rendered 'En-gedi'.

14:12.note: Order: 'Lot, son of Abram's brother, and his goods'.

14:14.note: 'His brother' rendered 'his brother's son'; plus 'after them'.

15:1.note: 'Shield' rendered 'I will help you'; plus leh.

15:2.note: Ariri rendered 'without sons'; mesheq read as heir ('inherits me').

15:4.note: 'Behold the word of the LORD' rendered 'the LORD said'; plus 'your son'.

15:9.note: Order heifer-ram-goat (MT heifer-goat-ram); 'for me' rendered 'for you'.

16:1.note: 'She had' rendered with 'it was to her'.

16:7.note: 'At the spring' (8-9) not repeated; Shur rendered 'Gadar'.

16:12.note: 'Wild ass of a man' rendered 'among men'; 'face' rendered 'border'.

16:13.note: Plus 'and she said'; cognate object 'vision' plus.

16:15.note: Doublet 'who was born to him, whom Hagar bore him'.

17:1.note: Plus 'God' after El Shaddai; 'walk' rendered 'be pleasing'; tamim 'without blemish'.

17:6.note: Plus 'and I will multiply you'; 'from you' rendered 'from your loins'.

17:16.note: Second blessing on the son ('him') rather than 'her'.

17:26.note: Passive 'was circumcised' rendered active with Ishmael as object.

18:1.note: Word-for-word; כחם rendered by clause "when the day was hot".

18:4.note: Syriac "I will take" (active) for passive יקח; נא unrendered.

18:10.note: כעת חיה paraphrased "at this time while she is alive"; והנה as "and there shall be"; plus "to him".

18:14.note: Free rendering "Is a thing too great for the Lord"; plus "and shall be" and "your wife" (harmonized with v.10).

18:19.note: Word-for-word; למען אשר absorbed by relative ד.

18:20.note: כי רבה rendered "has come up before me"; כבדה מאד as "grew very strong".

18:23.note: האף read as "in one anger"; nouns plural.

18:25.note: Plus "this" after judgment; passive "will not be done".

18:29.note: Plus "Abraham"; ויאמר minus; "I will not destroy if I find there" for "not do for the sake of".

18:30.note: "I will not destroy" for "I will not do".

19:1.note: Plus object "them" after "saw"; אפים as "upon his face".

19:2.note: הנה נא rendered "I beg of you"; כי unrendered.

19:9.note: Plus "with us", "and behold", "us"; ויפצרו as "strove with the men".

19:12.note: עד מי לך פה rendered freely "what are you doing here"; plus "this".

19:14.note: Plus "to them"; העיר replaced by pronoun "it".

19:18.note: אל נא rendered "I beg of you".

19:25.note: "inhabitants of the land" for "of the cities".

19:34.note: ממחרת as "on the next day"; plus "this" night.

20:1.note: Kadesh rendered Reqam, Shur and Gerar as Gadar; plus repeated "Abraham".

20:4.note: Plus "Abimelech"; הגוי גם צדיק as "even a righteous people".

20:16.note: Free paraphrase of כסות עינים; "with me" for "with you"; ונכחת as "rebuke me".

21:6.note: צחק rendered "great joy"; plus "today"; יצחק as "will rejoice".

21:20.note: Plus "of Paran" (wilderness); רבה קשת as "learned the bow".

21:25.note: Plus "which the servants of Abraham dug and".

22:2.note: Moriah rendered "land of the Amorites"; plus "to him"; נא unrendered.

22:3.note: ויחבש rendered "put (a saddle) on"; ויבקע as "split".

22:11.note: "angel of God" for "angel of the LORD".

22:15.note: "angel of God" for "angel of the LORD"; שנית as "a second time".

22:20.note: Impersonal passive rendered "and they told him".

23:2.note: Kiriath-arba interpreted "city of the giants"; plus copula; לספד as "to lament (dance) over".

23:4.note: גר ותושב order inverted ("resident and sojourner").

23:6.note: נשיא אלהים as "great one of God".

23:8.note: Plus "to them"; את נפשכם as "your souls are willing".

23:10.note: Plus "and said"; לכל as "and before all".

23:13.note: לו rendered "you are willing"; plus "to you"; כסף השדה as "money, the price of the field".

23:16.note: עבר לסחר as "current with the merchant".

23:17.note: Doublet "the field of the cave and the cave"; Machpelah as "double".

23:20.note: Doublet "of the cave and the cave".

24:2.note: Restructured: "Abraham called his servant ... and said to him"; plus "great"; נא unrendered.

24:8.note: תאבה as "be persuaded"; אחריך as "with you".

24:21.note: Syriac word 2 unclear (left unlinked); משתאה לה as "examining her".

24:27.note: אנכי read as "but"; plus "to take the daughter of my master's brother for his son".

24:39.note: "will not be willing to come with me".

24:45.note: Plus "a little water from your jar" (harmonized with v.17).

24:47.note: Bracelets first; ring "on her ears" for "on her nose".

24:48.note: Plus "to the house of my master's brother".

24:55.note: ימים או עשור rendered "a month of days".

24:62.note: Beer-lahai-roi translated "well of the Living One who sees me".

25:8.note: Plus "his days" ("full of days", as SamP/LXX).

25:11.note: Beer-lahai-roi translated; עם as "by the bank of".

25:32.note: Plus "in his heart"; Syriac word 10 unclear (left unlinked).

26:7.note: Plus copula; "kill him" in third person.

26:12.note: שערים read as "barley" (שעורים); first ההוא minus.

26:18.note: Plus "the servants of his father" (cf. v.15).

27:2.note: Plus "to him Isaac"; "the day on which I will die"; נא unrendered.

27:3.note: תליך rendered "your sword"; לי and נא unrendered.

27:18.note: Plus "and he said" before "who are you".

27:35.note: Plus "to him his father"; blessings plural.

27:36.note: Plus "Esau" twice and "to his father"; הכי as "truly".

27:41.note: ימי אבל as "days of the house of mourning".

28:14.note: ופרצת as "you will increase"; east/west order swapped.

29:2.note: Flock of sheep as two words; "lo there" merged.

29:5.note: Explicit pronoun with participle; "to him" plus.

29:6.note: "Is he well" with pronoun for lo; "to him" plus.

29:7.note: Adds "to them Jacob"; "great" paraphrased as "the day still stands".

29:20.note: "Few days" as "little days"; "in his love" paraphrased by clause.

29:24.note: Word order rearranged: recipient Leah before Zilpah.

30:2.note: "To her" plus; anger idiom rendered literally.

30:6.note: Word-for-word (verb form for "judged me" as transmitted).

30:8.note: "Wrestlings of God" paraphrased as "I sought from the LORD and prayed".

30:11.note: Ketiv/qere ba gad rendered "my fortune came".

30:15.note: Question paraphrased "is it not enough for you"; "Leah" plus.

30:31.note: Adds names; הזה replaced by 'which I tell you' (all three words linked to it).

30:36.note: Syriac reads "between him and Laban" for "between him and Jacob".

30:38.note: Unclear word ܟܪ left unaligned; "troughs of water" reordered.

30:39.note: Three colour terms rendered by two.

31:2.note: "Lo" minus; face rendered with suffix construction.

31:13.note: "I am" doubled; "to me" plus after anointed.

31:14.note: Question rendered as negative statement; "to him" minus.

31:16.note: Peshitta has "LORD" for Elohim in second half.

31:18.note: "Cattle of his getting which he gathered" minus.

31:27.note: Particle "then" plus; harp and timbrel reversed.

31:29.note: "It is in the power of my hand" idiom; "saying" minus.

31:39.note: "I bore its loss" rendered "I guarded it".

32:3.note: Copula plus; object pronoun for suffix.

32:10.note: Adds "he prayed"; "your land" as "land of your fathers"; "Jacob" minus.

32:12.note: Double "from the hand of" condensed; "please" minus.

33:7.note: Rachel and Joseph in reversed order.

33:9.note: "Let it be yours" rendered "keep what is yours".

33:11.note: "Please" minus; "favored me" rendered "had mercy on me".

33:19.note: Tent clause moved to end; qesitah rendered "lambs".

34:3.note: "Clung" rendered "went out after"; "spoke to her heart" rendered "filled her heart".

34:24.note: Order reversed: Shechem and Hamor his father.

35:5.note: "Sons of Jacob" rendered "Jacob and his sons".

35:27.note: Kiriath-arba rendered "city of giants"; adds "in the land of Canaan".

35:29.note: Adds "in the tomb which Abraham his father bought".

36:6.note: "Cattle" merged; destination given as "land of Seir".

36:10.note: Order of Eliphaz and Reuel reversed.

36:14.note: "Daughter of Zibeon" rendered "son of Zibeon"; "were" minus.

36:16.note: Korah and Gatam in reversed order.

36:26.note: Dishan spelled Dishon; Hemdan as Hamran.

36:39.note: Hadar read as Hadad; "daughter of Me-zahab" rendered "son".

37:2.note: "Lad" rendered "grew up"; Zilpah's sons named before Bilhah's.

37:30.note: "Where is he" for "he is not"; "to them" plus.

37:33.note: "My son" repeated at end; copula plus.

37:36.note: "Chief of the executioners" rendered "chief of the guards".

38:14.note: Enaim rendered "parting of the ways"; "as wife" minus.

39:11.note: "Joseph" plus; "this day" rendered "one of the days".

39:18.note: "Went out" plus; "beside me" rendered "in my hands".

40:19.note: "Lift your head from you" rendered "take your head".

41:1.note: "Two years" for dual; ימים unrendered; cognate object "dream" added.

41:5.note: שנית as "a second time"; בריאות rendered "full".

41:6.note: שדופת קדים = "beaten by the wind of scorching".

41:8.note: "of Pharaoh" added after his spirit; Egypt moved after wise men.

41:13.note: ויהי unrendered; extra ܠܢ (plus); כני = "my position".

41:15.note: Participial "you hear ... and interpret" with pronoun.

41:16.note: Plus "lest you think that" interpreting בלעדי; את unrendered.

41:23.note: One adjective for צנמות דקות; קדים as "wind of scorching".

41:34.note: וחמש paraphrased "take one of five"; Egypt added after land.

41:45.note: Name glossed "who reveals hidden things" (plus); plus "all".

41:54.note: Negation ܠܐ against MT (no bread in Egypt?), left unlinked.

42:1.note: "Why do you look at one another" rendered "do not fear" (reading from ירא); ܠܐ left unlinked.

42:5.note: הבאים = "those who were going"; היה = "was strong".

42:6.note: אפים = "upon their faces"; ארצה "upon the ground".

42:7.note: Plus "we come" in reply; באתם rendered by pronoun only.

42:12.note: Plus "Joseph"; לא paraphrased "it is not so".

42:16.note: Plus "if you have spoken" in truth clause; אתכם unrendered.

42:27.note: Plus "of them"; מלון = "lodging house"; הנה הוא = "placed".

42:28.note: Sack = "mouth of my load"; plus ܗܘ, ܗܝ.

43:6.note: Plus "to them" and "their father"; העוד = "if there is".

43:15.note: Plus "and they led with them" before Benjamin.

43:28.note: Doubled "and they said to him" plus; ketiv/qere linked to qere.

44:1.note: אשר על ביתו = "his steward"; sacks = "their loads".

44:2.note: Plus imperative "take" and subject "the servant"; אשר דבר unrendered.

44:4.note: ܡܢ renders the את-construction "out of the city".

44:16.note: "God found" = "found from before God"; pronouns added.

44:18.note: בי = "I beg of you"; ear = "before you".

44:20.note: "child of old age" = "son, son of old age".

45:3.note: Plus "I" doubled and "your brother"; לענות = "give him a word".

45:4.note: Plus "to him", "to them", doubled "I"; נא unrendered.

45:10.note: "Sons of your sons" = "sons of your house".

45:19.note: Expanded: "behold you have authority; say to your brothers"; wives/children reversed.

45:23.note: ולחם rendered "and wine"; plus "of the land".

45:27.note: Plus "Jacob" as subject; ותחי = "was at rest".

45:28.note: Expanded "great is this to me"; Israel unrendered.

47:15.note: ולמה paraphrased "and let us not die".

47:29.note: Plus "and I will make you swear by the LORD".

48:4.note: מפרך rendered "bless you"; periphrastic participles with pronouns.

48:5.note: "mine are they" repeated before Reuben and Simeon (plus).

48:7.note: Plus "of Aram"; כברת ארץ = "about a parasang's journey of land".

48:12.note: Plural "they bowed" with plus "before him"; Joseph unrendered.

49:1.note: Plus "to them"; את אשר rendered "that which".

49:4.note: פחז = "you erred"; חללת = "you defiled (smeared)"; אז rendered "truly" (unlinked).

49:7.note: Plus copula ܗܘ; עז = "they are strong".

49:10.note: Shiloh read as שלו "he to whom it belongs"; מחקק = "interpreter".

49:11.note: שרקה = "branch"; כבס = "whiten"; ketiv/qere linked to qere.

49:13.note: חוף אניות = "harbour (?) of ships"; plus "his border unto".

49:14.note: חמר גרם = "a mighty man"; משפתים = "the paths".

49:22.note: Free rendering of עלי עין / צעדה.

49:33.note: Plus "and he fell ill"; ויאסף רגליו = "stretched out his feet".

50:5.note: כריתי rendered "I bought"; plus "to me", pronoun.

50:10.note: האטד = Atar; אבל = "house of weeping"; מאד unrendered.

50:15.note: Plus "and they feared"; לו read as "lest".
